description: For TOP 3 over a unique ordering and TOP 4 over an ordering whose fourth and fifth rows tie, as a dynaset and as a snapshot: read Type, Updatable, Bookmarkable, RecordCount, the Fields Count; then BOF, EOF, AbsolutePosition, PercentPosition and the value of field 0 at the first row; MoveLast and read the same and RecordCount; MoveNext (past the end) and read; MovePrevious and read; MovePrevious again; MoveFirst, MovePrevious (before the start) and read; MoveFirst, Move 2 and read; Move -1 and read. Asks the position, count and boundary states of a recordset whose source is not a plain table, per requested type, and which requests are refused. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-def-cursor-dao probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
